title: kate-ui: type, move, undo, and paint every caret
summary: The window inserts typed text and moves every caret. Undo, redo, and Save use the existing commands. Marked text stays off the buffer until the input method commits it. Paint draws every caret and every selection. This packet does not open files and does not bind Cmd-O, Cmd-N, or Cmd-W. The keymap module does not import GPUI, so Linux CI can test it.

lane.reason: session.rs and paint.rs compile only on macOS. The rust (macos-15) check is the GPUI build evidence. The owner must type on his Mac and confirm an input-method commit. Linux CI runs the keymap tests.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: lib.rs adds mod keys with no cfg gate. session.rs binds the table through command_for_binding and does not copy the match. replace_text_in_range runs command_for_commit and then clears the composition. The marked-text handler stays as it is. After each executed command, scroll.first_line becomes reveal_line for the primary caret. snapshot stores caret_marks and selection_spans. paint draws each span with the selection color and each caret mark. The primary caret still sets caret_bounds for the input method. Cmd-Q and the Quit menu stay. Do not add a dependency. Do not edit the four highlight tests. A new Rust file starts with the GPL-3.0-or-later SPDX header.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::binding_table_matches_existing_commands
regression_tests.asserts: Each table row returns that command. cmd-o, cmd-n, cmd-w, and cmd-shift-s return None. An unknown binding returns None.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::commit_inserts_text_and_empty_commit_does_not
regression_tests.asserts: command_for_commit of a\nb is InsertText of that string. An empty string returns None.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::spans_cover_each_line_of_a_selection
regression_tests.asserts: In ab\ncd, a selection from offset 1 through 4 yields a span on line 0 and a span on line 1. A caret yields a mark and no span. Column 1 of e-acute is byte 2.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::reveal_line_puts_the_caret_in_the_window
regression_tests.asserts: A caret inside the window keeps first_line. A caret above moves to that line. A caret below uses caret_line + 1 - visible_rows. Zero rows leaves first_line unchanged.
